Hymn 221: Dear to the Heart of the Shepherd
Time Signature: 6/8
Musical Key: A-flat Major
Composer: William J. Kirkpatrick
Lyricist/Text Author: Mary B. Wingate
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 221 titled "Dear to the Heart of the Shepherd" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 6/8 time signature. 
The music was composed by William J. Kirkpatrick and the lyrics were written by Mary B. Wingate.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
